study_identification_part.si4_title: Social behavior in ASD males: The interplay between cognitive flexibility, working memory, and functional connectivity deviations

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Evaluate whether individual deviations in between-network resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) map to social behavior in ASD males, and test whether executive functions mediate these associations.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Sparse CCA (PMA) relating deviation scores to SRS subscales (5 components; L1=0.1 via CCA.permute); Mediation analysis (mediation v4.5.0; 5,000 bootstraps) testing BRIEF (GEC and 8 domains) as mediators; Mann–Whitney tests for group differences in key deviations.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Higher VAN–DMN, SMN–FPN, and VAN–FPN deviation z-scores associate with greater social behavioral problems; cognitive flexibility and working memory significantly mediate the VAN–DMN deviation to social behavior pathway.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Normative GAM trajectories trained on non-ASD males (n=321) were applied to testing data (n=495). Deviation scores in VAN×DMN, SMN×FPN, and VAN×FPN showed positive correlations with SRS subscales (e.g., VAN×DMN with Awareness r=0.272; Communication r=0.215; Cognition r=0.200). Mediation: BRIEF GEC partially mediated the VAN×DMN z to SRS total (ACME=2.956, p=0.0028); domain-level mediation significant for Cognitive Flexibility (ACME=2.839, p=0.0048) and Working Memory (ACME=2.258, p=0.0044) after Bonferroni correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Demonstrates feasibility of individual-level rsFC deviation charts in ASD; potential utility for precision stratification and targeting executive function (cognitive flexibility, working memory) for intervention.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Single-domain dataset (ABIDE) without external validation; male-only cohort limits generalizability; cross-sectional design precludes developmental causal inference; lack of standard NM performance metrics (e.g., EV/MSLL) on test HCs; ComBat-based batch removal may risk information distortion if not fully matched.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: 21 between-network features from Yeo 7-network parcellation (VN, SMN, DAN, VAN, LN, FPN, DMN). Harmonization across 18 batches (site + scan parameters) via neuroCombat. GAM specification: y ~ s(ScanAge, k=kno, bs='tp') + QC_meanmotion; family=gaussian; method=REML (see Supplementary Table 4). Training/test split within ABIDE males under 14 years: 321 non-ASD (train), 77 non-ASD (test), 418 ASD (test).
